verdict.rationale: The product is itself OpenAI's official SDK. It ships first-party Python and JavaScript/TypeScript libraries, hosted in the openai GitHub org, with extensive docs covering agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, tracing, MCP and realtime. Community users report building with it hands-on and find it simpler than alternatives. Missing for 10: no evidence of SDKs beyond Python and JS, and no install, versioning, or stability guarantees in the pack.
